scope: Public development evidence: a fixed subset of the 231 accessible public JevBench items, scored with documented v1.5 Noul/Score rules. The method reports 601 published-open and 904 total open items. The additional 370 published-open items are absent from this pinned source. These public items have informed development; this is not a blind or sealed evaluation, the official I_open, or a leaderboard composite.
status_transitions: v1.5 decisions; Noul abstentions count as incorrect in aggregate accuracy
privacy: Aggregates only; no task IDs, task text, gold labels, raw probabilities or responses
limitation: Descriptive paired development diagnostics; no inference test, uncertainty estimate or new generalization claim
